messages.subject: fread dec argument compatibility within shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi all,

I have a shiny app using the fread function from the R data.table package.

I am able to run it locally quite easily.
But on shinyapps.io, whenever I set the "dec" argument of the function to anything other than the default, the app crashes.

I thinks it comoes from the fact that the fread function would then modify the system default to the specified decimal point, and change it back when the function finished running.

Has anyone esle had the issue before?

Thank you for your help,
Robin
